profile.headline: Backend Magician | AWS Architect | Node.js & GraphQL Enthusiast
profile.summary:
Senior Backend Engineer with 5+ years of experience architecting and implementing scalable, high-performance solutions. Specialized in:

Building robust backend services with Node.js and GraphQL
Designing serverless architectures using AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, EC2, RDS)
Optimizing database performance (PostgreSQL, MongoDB)
Implementing efficient message queuing systems (RabbitMQ)

Known for:
✓ Solving complex technical challenges
✓ Enhancing system performance and user experience
✓ Leading incident management and resolution
✓ Mentoring junior developers and fostering knowledge sharing

Looking to leverage my expertise in backend development, cloud architecture, and agile methodologies at a forward-thinking tech company with global impact.
Let's connect if you're looking for a backend specialist who can drive innovation and deliver scalable solutions!

positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Lead the design and implementation of complex software systems and features, ensuring alignment with architectural best practices and business goals.
- Research and evaluate viable technical options, making well-reasoned architectural decisions and presenting them clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Leverage expertise in AWS services to design highly available, scalable, and cost-effective cloud-native solutions.
- Architect and optimize data models and interactions for performance and reliability.
- Oversee the full lifecycle of complex software initiatives—from discovery and planning to implementation and post-launch support.
- Proactively monitor project progress, identify risks, and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery.
-Provide regular, clear, and concise updates on project status, technical challenges, and solutions to all relevant stakeholders.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
-Collaborates with members of the product team to ensure success and development proficiency.
-Executes development, testing, and peer review of product capabilities and accelerators.
-Ensures efficient and on-time delivery of product features and capabilities.
-Creates new and innovative ideas by participating in discovery sessions.
-Maintains & reviews internal technology infrastructure, including security, performance & support.

positions.title: Full-Stack Engineer
positions.description: I was hired to work on different projects by various clients. I worked on creating all the ideas and inspiration that these businesses envisioned for their site to gain traction and brought this to the real world through the front-end of their websites.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded JavaScript (EJS) · Tailwind CSS · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · MongoDB · Bootstrap · Node.js · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed full-stack web applications across multiple platforms with a team of distributed engineers using Javascript, React, MongoDB and Node.js.
Maintained detailed git history for all projects and used Github in a team environment.
• Use HTML, CSS, Javascript to build dynamic web applications
• Utilize complex and simple API's
• Client work included multi-page websites, e-commerce site with stripe integration
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded JavaScript (EJS) · Tailwind CSS · MongoDB · Bootstrap · Node.js · JavaScript · React.js

positions.title: Assistant Hospital Manager
positions.locationName: West Hollywood, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Supported day-to-day hospital operations, ensuring efficient workflow across medical, client service, and administrative teams
- Performed Senior Veterinary Technician duties as needed, including advanced patient care, anesthesia monitoring, surgical assistance, diagnostics, and medication administration
- Provided front-of-house support as a veterinary receptionist, including client intake, scheduling, phone triage, estimates, and payment processing
- Acted as a point of escalation for complex client concerns, resolving complaints and conflicts with professionalism, empathy, and solution-oriented communication
- Addressed employee concerns and interpersonal conflicts, facilitating timely resolutions and escalating to leadership when appropriate
- Participated in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding of veterinary technicians, assistants, and client service representatives

positions.title: Senior Veterinary Technician
positions.locationName: West Hollywood, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
-Delivered advanced nursing care for medical and surgical patients in a fast-paced animal hospital setting
-Assisted veterinarians with exams, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures
-Performed venipuncture, catheter placement, radiography, laboratory testing, and medication administration
-Led anesthesia induction, monitoring, and recovery while maintaining patient safety and comfort
-Provided clear, compassionate client education on treatment plans, medications, and post-care instructions
-Ensured accurate medical record documentation and adherence to hospital protocols

positions.title: Veterinary Technician
positions.description:
The veterinary technician is the doctor’s primary medical support person. They begin
the examination procedure and continue to assist the doctor throughout the
examination, diagnosis and treatment phases. They aid the doctors in achieving
greater efficiency by relieving them of technical work and administrative detail. They
have a very significant role in communicating with clients about their pets. In this position I practice strong practical skills and medical knowledge, through excellent written and verbal communication skills.

positions.title: Lead Resident Assistant
positions.description: Resident Assistants (RA) are live-in, part-time student staff. Under the supervision of a Resident Director and Assistant Resident Director, RAs are responsible for the administration and implementation of the student development program in a residential community.

positions.title: Residential Technology Technician
positions.description:
• Foster collaboration through the technical support of campus student group programs, and UCLA Department & Corporate Partner efforts
• Facilitate engagement via marketing & promotional campaigns, presenting workshops, product demonstrations and larger scale programs (i.e. TechFair and GameFest)
• Attend weekly RTC meetings & other gatherings as directed
• Develop and implement programs & workshops as scheduled
• Communicate with the Resident Technology Supervisors (RTS) and provide required documents as requested
• Produce technically innovative training workshops, programs and activities each quarter
• Collaborate with departmental, campus wide and corporate partners to provide students access to resources for their growth and development
• Support outreach and marketing efforts for Learning Centers, MMAC and Makerspace efforts
• Contribute to developmental engagement
• Assist in the presentation of large scale programs

positions.title: Head Learning Assistant
positions.description: Learning Assistants (LA) teach in the Sciences at UCLA through an evidence-based, multidisciplinary instructional strategy. Undergraduate students who have succeeded in a given course receive credit to learn how to help the next group of students succeed in that course. LAs thus help facilitate active learning and collaborative instruction in lecture, discussion and/or lab.

honors.title: Phi Beta Kappa
honors.description: The Phi Beta Kappa Society (ΦΒΚ) is the oldest academic honor society in the United States,[1] and the most prestigious, due in part to its long history and academic selectivity.[2] Phi Beta Kappa aims to promote and advocate excellence in the liberal arts and sciences, and to induct the most outstanding students of arts and sciences at only select American colleges and universities.
honors.issuer: Issued by Phi Beta Kappa Honor Society · Jun 2020

honors.title: UCLA Achievement Scholarship
honors.description: The UCLA Achievement Scholarship is available at UCLA in recognition of students’ academic excellence. Entering freshmen are selected based on a comprehensive review of their university admissions applications by the UCLA Undergraduate Admission Office.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked with a team of other software developers to create Technology resources for Women in our area. Mainly worked on developing the front-end for these resources.
